subtitle: Lesson 29 · Security Fundamentals for SQL Server

code:
ALTER SERVER ROLE dbcreator
    ADD MEMBER [DOMAIN\jsmith];

-- sysadmin      unrestricted, everything
-- securityadmin manage logins & server perms
-- dbcreator     create/alter/drop/restore DBs
-- processadmin  KILL running processes
-- serveradmin   server config, SHUTDOWN
caption: public is implicit — every login is already a member.

code:
USE InventoryDB;
ALTER ROLE db_datareader ADD MEMBER app_reader;

-- db_owner        full control, one database
-- db_datareader    SELECT on every table/view
-- db_datawriter    INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, all tables
-- db_ddladmin      DDL only, no data access
-- db_denydatawriter  explicit deny, overrides grants
caption: The database-scoped equivalents of the fixed server roles.
